source_directory: Government of India (myScheme.gov.in) & Government of Karnataka (agri.karnataka.gov.in)
disclaimer: Scheme guidelines, subsidy percentages, and application windows are determined by respective State and Central Government departments. Farmers must verify active tenders and notifications with their local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or Common Service Center (CSC). AgriSaarthi does not guarantee financial disbursements.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.benefitAmount: ₹6,000 per year (in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each)
schemes.description: Direct Income Support transferred into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts to support agricultural inputs, seeds, and fertilizer expenses.
eligibility: Small, marginal, and landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names
Must have active Aadhaar e-KYC and land records seeded on PM-KISAN portal
Institutional landholders, current/former constitutional post holders, and income taxpayers are excluded
documents: Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC / Pahani)
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded / NPCI active)
Active Mobile Number for OTP Verification
schemes.procedure: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in (Farmer Corner) or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / Grama One centre.

schemes.name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme
schemes.benefitAmount: ₹10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 2.0 hectares / ₹20,000)
schemes.description: Karnataka State Government financial incentive for dryland farmers cultivating nutri-cereals / minor millets (Ragi, Foxtail, Little, Kodo, Barnyard, Proso millets).
eligibility: Farmers in Karnataka cultivating notified minor millets
Must be registered in the Karnataka FRUITS (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System) database with active FID
Crop cultivation must be verified through the Digital Crop Survey (Bele Jarip)
schemes.procedure: Ensure enrollment in the FRUITS database at the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) and verify your digital crop survey entry during Kharif season.

schemes.name: Krishi Bhagya Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.benefitAmount: Up to 80% - 90% subsidy for construction of Farm Ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene lining, diesel pumpsets, and micro-irrigation
schemes.description: Water harvesting and dryland farming initiative focusing on rainfall-dependent districts of Karnataka to harvest rainwater in farm ponds and provide life-saving protective irrigation.
eligibility: Dryland and rainfed farmers in Karnataka, with priority for drought-prone taluks
Small & Marginal farmers get 90% subsidy; general farmers get 80% subsidy
Must have clear title to agricultural land suitable for farm pond excavation
documents: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST higher subsidy entitlement)
schemes.procedure: Submit application to the Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) or local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.benefitAmount: Comprehensive crop loss insurance with very low farmer premium (2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops)
schemes.description: Yield-index and weather-index crop insurance protecting farmers against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rain, pests, and post-harvest cyclone damage).
eligibility: All farmers including loanee, non-loanee, tenant, and sharecroppers cultivating notified crops in notified insurance units
Timely enrollment before the seasonal cutoff deadline announced by Karnataka Department of Agriculture
documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Village Administrative Officer / RSK or Digital Crop Survey
schemes.procedure: Apply through the Samrakshane Karnataka Portal (samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in) or visit your bank branch / Common Service Center.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.benefitAmount: 100% Free Soil Testing and Customized Fertilizer Prescription Card issued every 2 years
schemes.description: Government initiative that tests farm soil samples across 12 chemical and micronutrient parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) to advise balanced fertilizer application.
eligibility: All landholding farmers across Karnataka and India
Soil samples collected by department agricultural officers or accredited village youth
schemes.procedure: Contact your local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or submit a soil sample to the nearest district Soil Testing Laboratory (STL).

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop
schemes.kannadaName: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಿಂಚಾಯಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ)
schemes.benefitAmount: Up to 90% subsidy for SC/ST farmers and up to 45% - 55% subsidy for Small/Marginal farmers for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems
schemes.description: Water efficiency program promoting micro-irrigation technologies (drip and sprinkler) to maximize water use efficiency, save water, and boost crop productivity.
eligibility: All categories of farmers with available water source (borewell, open well, canal, or farm pond)
Priority given to water-stressed taluks and horticultural crops
documents: Borewell test report or water source proof
schemes.procedure: Apply online through the Karnataka Horticulture Department portal or through the Assistant Director of Horticulture / RSK.

schemes.name: Krishi Yantradhare (Custom Hiring Centers - CHC)
schemes.benefitAmount: Heavy farm machinery, tractors, harvesters, rotavators, and weeders made available on hourly rental basis at 30% - 50% below commercial market rates
schemes.description: Farm mechanization initiative established at hobli-level Custom Hiring Service Centers to provide small and marginal farmers access to high-cost modern farm machinery without capital investment.
eligibility: All small, marginal, and medium farmers in Karnataka
First-come first-served booking during critical cultivation periods
documents: Aadhaar Card or FRUITS FID Number
schemes.procedure: Book machinery at your nearest Hobli Custom Hiring Center (CHC) or inquire at the local Raitha Samparka Kendra.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.benefitAmount: Short-term agricultural production credit up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive)
schemes.description: Institutional credit card designed to provide farmers with timely credit for purchase of seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and post-harvest working capital, insulating them from high-interest unorganized lenders.
eligibility: All farmers: individuals, joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
schemes.procedure: Visit your local commercial bank, RRB (Karnataka Gramin Bank), or Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS).
